apollo11.name: Apollo 11
apollo11.source: NASA Apollo 11 Mission Report MSC-00171 (events, positions, masses); JPL Horizons 301 (the Moon) and 10 (the Sun), UT, ecliptic J2000; the spacecraft's paths are integrated and fitted to the report, see scripts/mission_apollo11*.py

voyager1.name: Voyager 1
voyager1.source: JPL Horizons, the probe's and the planet's own vectors (zimi/static/earth/space-tracks-v1.json); closest approaches found by scripts/mission_probes.py

voyager2.name: Voyager 2
voyager2.source: JPL Horizons, the probe's and the planet's own vectors (zimi/static/earth/space-tracks-v1.json); closest approaches found by scripts/mission_probes.py

perseverance.name: Perseverance
perseverance.source: NASA/JPL Mars 2020 press kit (events), JPL Horizons -168 (the approach, Mars-centred, UT, ecliptic J2000); the entry and descent follow the published events between them (scripts/mission_perseverance.py), flown over the view's own Mars-fixed frame to the Perseverance pin in landmarks-v1.json
